description: Unit tests for the CertificateView class in the quiche QUIC library, testing PEM parsing, certificate parsing, signature verification, key matching, time parsing, and signature algorithm support.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Tests parsing of a single certificate and its attributes.

methods.name: ParseCertWithUnknownSanType
methods.description: Tests parsing of a certificate with an unknown SAN type.

methods.name: PemSingleCertificate
methods.description: Tests loading a single certificate from PEM.

methods.name: PemMultipleCertificates
methods.description: Tests loading multiple certificates from PEM.

methods.name: PemNoCertificates
methods.description: Tests behavior when no certificates are present in PEM.

methods.name: SignAndVerify
methods.description: Tests signing data with a private key and verifying with the certificate view.

methods.name: PrivateKeyPem
methods.description: Tests loading private keys from PEM and matching with certificate.

methods.name: PrivateKeyEcdsaPem
methods.description: Tests loading ECDSA private key from PEM.

methods.name: DerTime
methods.description: Tests parsing of DER-encoded time strings.

methods.name: NameAttribute
methods.description: Tests conversion of X.509 name attributes to string.

methods.name: SupportedSignatureAlgorithmsForQuicIsUpToDate
methods.description: Checks that supported signature algorithms are up-to-date.
